about: Published lap times of real GT3 cars at two of the five circuits we hold the geometry of. Facts (a time at a circuit), not a dataset: INDICATIVE, from news and results pages that are not the series' own timing, in qualifying trim. Used only as a lower bound: our Tornado GT3 must not lap faster than a real GT3 (0.95 x allows for the circuit length and line differences). Retrieved 2026-11-24.
